description: Canonical deployment targets for ParametriCAD AI. Every entry must cost 0 EUR (REQ-DEP-01). Any target flagged "sleeps": true is pinged every 5 minutes by .github/workflows/keepalive.yml (REQ-DEP-02). Do not add a paid tier without a matching ADR; the tests in backend/tests/unit/test_deployment_targets.py fail on violation.

targets.notes: Static Vite build. Always-on: static files are served by a CDN with no instance to suspend. Vercel Hobby is 100 GB egress/mo, which bounds the demo's traffic envelope.

Free-tier web service (Docker) hosting the FastAPI + CadQuery backend. Render suspends idle free instances and wakes them on traffic; keepalive.yml issues a GET to /health every 5 minutes so visitors never wait on a cold boot. The 512 MB instance is sized for the uvicorn process plus CadQuery/OpenCASCADE; if a generation ever approaches it, reduce tessellation density rather than upgrade the plan.
